# Slatebox documentation

Official guides for using the app, building with SlateboxJS, calling the HTTP API, and self-hosting.

Each guide has a GitHub mirror for command-line clients. You can also read [this index on GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/llms.txt).

[Hosted OpenAPI schema](https://api.slatebox.com/v1/openapi.json)

For a self-hosted instance, read /api/v1/openapi.json on that instance to discover the operations it supports.

[Current self-host release record](https://docs.slatebox.com/assets/self-host/release.json) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/assets/self-host/release.json)

## Using Slatebox
